l-e-e1-b07-02.title: e yeroo dhuma irratti dabalamu vowel akkamitti dubbifama?
l-e-e1-b07-02.goal: Fakkeenya hedduu jechoota e dhumaa qaban keessatti vowel akkamitti dubbifamu seera argii himi, fi seera sana haala haaraa waliin mirkaneessi.
l-e-e1-b07-02.material: e yoo dabalame, sagaleen ni jijjiirama. cap (sagalee a gabaabaa) -> cape (sagalee a dheeraa), kit (sagalee i gabaabaa) -> kite (sagalee i dheeraa), hop (sagalee o gabaabaa) -> hope (sagalee o dheeraa). Seera argii pine dubbisi.
l-e-e1-b07-02.s.s1.prompt: Seerri yoo hojjete, i pine keessa, kan pin e dabalameef, akkamitti dubbifama?
l-e-e1-b07-02.s.s1.o.a: Akka maqaa qubee i dubbisi, sagalee dheeraa 'eye' tiin
l-e-e1-b07-02.s.s1.o.b: Akka pin gabaabsiitii dubbisi, sagalee gabaabaa 'ih' tiin
l-e-e1-b07-02.s.s1.r.b: Kun sagalee gabaabaa e dabalamuu dura ture dha. Seera dhiisa.
l-e-e1-b07-02.s.s1.r.c: Sagalee maqaa qubee e dabalame tiin dubbifame. Kun seera irraa adda dha.
l-e-e1-b07-02.s.s1.r.d: Sagaleen i ni jijjiirama, kan e miti.
l-e-e1-b07-02.s.s1.explain: e yoo dabalame, vowel gidduu sagalee maqaa qubee isaa fudhata. Cape sagalee 'ay' qaba, kite sagalee 'eye' qaba, fi hope sagalee 'oh' qaba.
l-e-e1-b07-02.s.s2.model.0: Cape, kite, fi hope keessatti, vowel gidduu e yoo dabalame sagalee maqaa qubee isaa fudhata, kanaaf i pine keessa jiru illee sagalee 'eye' tiin dubbifama.
l-e-e1-b07-02.s.s2.model.1: Jechoota sadan hundaa keessatti e dhuma irratti yoo dabalame vowel akka maqaa qubee isaa dheeraa ta'a, kanaaf pin pine yoo ta'u, i sagalee 'eye' fudhata.

l-e-e1-b07-03.title: Jechoota callisuu gaafatan filachuu
l-e-e1-b07-03.goal: Kutaa keessatti callisuu gaafachuuf maal akka jettu tiif, haalota wal faallessan hundaa yaadi, tilmaama isa caalaa gaarii filadhu, fi sababa isaa ibsi.
l-e-e1-b07-03.material: Barsiisaan namoonni hundi callisan jedhu mallattoo gabatee irratti barreessuu barbaada. Haalota sadan: gaaffii kabajaa, jechoota Ingiliffaa 3 ykn isa gadi, fi hiika "callisi."
l-e-e1-b07-03.s.s1.prompt: Hima haalota sadan hundaa guutu filadhu.
l-e-e1-b07-03.s.s1.r.a: Jechoota lama qaba, garuu "please" hin qabu, kanaaf kabajaa miti.
l-e-e1-b07-03.s.s1.r.c: Kabajaa dha, garuu jechoota afur qaba, kanaaf haala eeyyamame caalaa dheeraa dha.
l-e-e1-b07-03.s.s1.r.d: Kabajaa fi gabaabaa dha, garuu hiikni isaa "teessi" dha.
l-e-e1-b07-03.s.s1.explain: "Please be quiet." "please" qaba, kanaaf kabajaa dha, jechoota sadan qaba, fi "callisi" jechuu dha.
